description:
We are Space Archeology, a team of undergraduate students majoring in Management. We are participating in the NASA Hackathon to challenge ourselves, bring creative ideas to life, and gain new experience.

We are creative, ambitious, open-minded, and team-oriented. We are looking for like-minded people who are passionate about space, technology, and innovation, have skills in programming, design, or data analysis, or are simply eager to share ideas and learn new things.
